description_en: Queries the status of a data shipping task of a log
description_zh: 查询日志分析类型投递状态
name: GetLogMeta

parameters.help_en:
The name of the dedicated Logstore in which logs are stored.

>  You can call the [DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~) operation to query the name of the Logstore
parameters.help_zh:
日志存放的专属Logstore名称。
>您可以调用[DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: log_store

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
>调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id
